source.original_question: As shown in the figure, PA and PB are tangent to circle O, the tangent EF of circle O intersects PA and PB at points E and F respectively.

audit.independent_solution: Tangents from the same point have equal lengths: PA=PB=2, EA=EC, FB=FC. Thus PE+PF+EF=PE+PF+EC+FC=PA+PB=4.
